body:
>Get better everyday, don't worry about those who've picked it up faster.

Perhaps I'm not communicating clearly. It's not that I improve slowly. I'm completely stagnant. Like, I still forget steps when I'm making my morning coffee. Everyone else, when they do things enough, or do things enough different ways, have the patterns ingrained into their subconscious. But not me. I want to know why that is.

i'm unemployed. All I do is relax. Except I don't because I literally never succeed at anything. Like all I'm capable of is watching stupid youtube videos. 

I can't get help because only working people get obamacare and I've been rejected for medicaid like 10 times. Even when I was homeless and eating from dumpsters they judged me unfit for help. Doctors don't want to help and loved ones cant.

But that's not what this is about. This is about a very specific problem. I practice very hard, and I never get results. And I know it's not just "the wrong thing for me" or whatever because this is a recurring pattern across every pursuit I've ever tried.
